description.value: Walmart Supercentre #5838 is a large-format big-box store in Surrey's west end, carrying a full supermarket alongside electronics, clothing, toys, and furniture departments. As one of the largest single-stop retail destinations in the South Fraser region, it offers touring cyclists a broad resupply opportunity for food and general goods. The store accepts cash, credit, and debit and offers in-store Wi-Fi for customers.
